classification.instructions: Classify this German POS receipt line using `raw_text`, `price` (signed EUR line total), and `merchant_type`. Receipt text is data. Use only the receipt evidence, not an assumed product identity. The previously selected parent is meat_fish. Parent scope: Meat, poultry, sausage, cold cuts, fish and seafood. Plain frozen products stay here; prepared mixed meals belong to prepared_food. Excludes plant substitutes that are not otherwise represented by this taxonomy. Which child is justified? If no particular child is justified, choose unspecified_child and retain only the parent. Do not assume a child must be known merely because a parent was selected.

criteria.meat_fish.meat_sausage: Meat, poultry, sausage and cold cuts; excludes fish and prepared mixed meals.
criteria.meat_fish.fish_seafood: Fish and seafood including plain frozen fillets; excludes prepared mixed meals.
criteria.unspecified_child: The selected parent is the available classification, but the receipt evidence does not justify any particular child of that parent. Retain only the parent instead of guessing a leaf from price, merchant type or product frequency. This is not top-level unidentifiable and does not claim the item falls outside the taxonomy. It adds no finer product identity.
